title: 8. JOIN (inner join)
prompt:
JOIN means an inner join: only rows that match in both tables.

Return students.name and houses.head, matching students.house to houses.name.

Yellow (head Ms Patel) has no students, so that house must not appear.

(Order does not matter.)
starterQuery:
SELECT students.name, houses.head
FROM students
JOIN houses ON
solutionQuery: SELECT students.name, houses.head FROM students JOIN houses ON students.house = houses.name;
